commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Juventus out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
90+4' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
89' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
87' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Anastasios Douvikas and he is replaced by Alvaro Morata (Como).
87' The referee allows time for a substitution. Maxence Caqueret will be replaced by Alberto Moreno (Como).
84' Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) produces a shot on goal from a mid-range free kick. It heads towards the top right corner, but the keeper averts the danger with a stunning save!
84' Here is a change. Kenan Yildiz is going off and Luciano Spalletti gives the last tactical orders to Vasilije Adzic (Juventus).
83' Here comes a substitution. Andrea Cambiaso is given a rest as he is replaced by Filip Kostic (Juventus).
82' A free kick on the edge of the box for Juventus. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
81' Maximo Perrone (Como) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
81' Juventus are ruled offside.
78' 9:10 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
74' Khephren Thuram will be replaced by Jeremie Boga (Juventus).
74' It is time for a substitution. Jonathan David (Juventus) is on for Lois Openda.
74' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Diego Carlos (Como) replaces Mergim Vojvoda.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) will replace Lucas Da Cunha.
73' A yellow-coloured card is received by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus).
73' The Como players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

69' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt.
69' Jacobo Ramon (Como) brings his opponent down. Daniele Doveri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
66' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

65' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) climbs highest in the middle of the box after a cross from the wing, but sends a good looking header narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
64' The ball goes out of play and Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
63' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:2.

61' 0 - 2 Goal! Lucas Da Cunha displays great vision and sends a pass to Maxence Caqueret (Como), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 0:2.
60' Cesc Fabregas is forced to make a change. Martin Baturina (Como) is unable to continue due to injury, Sergi Roberto comes on.
60' Juventus force a corner. They send men into the box.
58' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
58' Maximo Perrone (Como) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniele Doveri stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
56' Martin Baturina (Como) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
54' Como are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
52' CHANCE! Anastasios Douvikas (Como) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
52' Como take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
51' One of the players from Juventus times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
50' The ball possession at the moment is 49:51.

49' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Jean Butez pulls off an easy save.
48' Ivan Smolcic (Como) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
47' Wonderful movement by Juventus. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
46' Half-time substitution. Fabio Miretti (Juventus) is replaced by Francisco Conceicao.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Daniele Doveri has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) probably handled the ball.

45+3' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
45+2' Lois Openda (Juventus) is flagged for offside.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
43' Surely that's handball by one of the Juventus players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
43' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Como.
40' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) jumps into a tackle and Daniele Doveri signals a foul.
38' Juventus fail to score from a corner as Jean Butez (Como) leaps to collect the ball.
38' CLOSE! Lucas Da Cunha (Como) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that whistles over the bar.
34' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Martin Baturina (Como) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
34' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.
32' Great teamplay by Como as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
29' A corner kick by Juventus is thwarted by the well prepared Jean Butez (Como).
28' A pass lands at the feet of Federico Gatti (Juventus) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Juventus earn a corner.
27' Juventus keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
25' The resulting set piece from Como is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

25' Alex Valle (Como) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Como.

22' Lois Openda (Juventus) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Jean Butez to get hold of the ball.
22' Jacobo Ramon (Como) tries to find Anastasios Douvikas, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

20' My Gran could have done better! Lois Openda (Juventus) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
18' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
17' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle and signals a foul after Lucas Da Cunha (Como) brought his opponent down.
16' Como seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

14' Maxence Caqueret (Como) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Como.
11' 0 - 1 Mergim Vojvoda (Como) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes inside the right post and past the goalkeeper.
8' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle after Lucas Da Cunha (Como) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
6' A player from Como commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
5' Great touch by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
5' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Juventus.
4' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Juventus force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

4' Martin Baturina (Como) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
2' The Como players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri is the one to supervise the game today.
